# Count ledger
Implement summarize(lines),which reads iterable text lines name:count and returns
a dict of summed counts for each name. Strip surrounding whitespace. Skip blank
lines and lines whose first non-space character is #. Names may contain Unicode;
preserve their text after trimming. Counts must be nonnegative integers; malformed
records,empty names,and negative counts raise ValueError. Repeated names add,
not replace. Do not modify tests. Run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v

New API requirement: summarize(lines, *, casefold=False). Preserve all current behavior by default. If casefold=True, normalize each trimmed name with Unicode str.casefold() before accumulating counts. Validation and one-pass iterator support remain unchanged. No external dependencies.

New API requirement: summarize(lines, *, casefold=False, min_count=0). min_count must be a nonnegative integer; reject booleans, floats, strings, None and negative integers with ValueError, including for empty input. Apply the threshold only after all records have been aggregated (and casefolded if enabled). Keep totals >= min_count. Default0 preserves zero totals. Preserve all prior validation and one-pass iteration.

New requirement: summarize(lines, *, casefold=False, min_count=0, exclude=()). exclude is a possibly one-pass iterable of names to omit. Strip surrounding whitespace from supplied exclusions and use Unicode casefold for both sides only when casefold=True. Aggregate and validate all records normally, then omit excluded names and apply min_count. Invalid records still raise even if their names are excluded. Default empty exclude preserves all prior behavior.
